howItWorks.title: How Clozer thinks
howItWorks.description: What happens behind every link you send, and why you have almost nothing to do.
howItWorks.intro: Clozer sees how your prospect reads your document, understands where the sale stands the way a seasoned salesperson would, and gets the right follow-up ready at the right time. You approve, and you call the ones who are ready.

afterSend.title: After you send: what happens
afterSend.sentTitle: How Clozer knows the link went out
afterSend.sentBody: Copying the link isn't enough: until Clozer knows it went out, it follows up with no one. The link counts as sent when:

sentWays.extension: you send it from Gmail or Outlook with the extension or the Outlook add-in: it's picked up on its own;
sentWays.button: you click “I sent it” on the prospect's page (Clozer asks you on Today after a copy);
sentWays.opened: the prospect opens it: the first opening counts as sent, even if you confirmed nothing.

afterSend.casesTitle: Then, depending on what the prospect does

notSent.title: Not sent yet
notSent.body: Nothing goes to the prospect. The link stays under “To send” on Today.

unopened.title: Sent, never opened
unopened.body: A reminder 3, 7 then 14 days after sending. The last one simply offers to close the file. A reminder you didn't approve is replaced by the next one, they don't pile up.

clicked.title: Clicked without reading
clicked.body: They stopped at the screen asking for their email: the reminder takes it into account and sends the link again without pushing.

read.title: Opened and read
read.body: No more “never opened” reminders. Clozer analyses how they read and prepares the follow-up that fits, at the right time. You're told about the readings that matter.

replied.title: They reply by email
replied.body: The reply lands in your inbox as usual. Clozer sees it too when it answers a Clozer follow-up, a Gmail thread with the extension, or when your cold email tool reports it (Smart Link): automatic follow-ups stop and you're notified. “Resume follow-ups” on the prospect's page turns them back on.

decided.title: They approve, ask for a change or book a meeting
decided.body: Everything stops and you're notified right away: your move.

bounced.title: Invalid address
bounced.body: The reminder couldn't be delivered: no more email goes to that address and you're notified so you can fix it on the prospect's page.

expiring.title: The link is about to expire
expiring.body: For a quote or a proposal, a reminder about two days before the deadline.

afterSend.casesNote: In copilot mode (the default), every follow-up waits for you in “Follow-ups to approve”: nothing goes out without you.

howItWorks.journeyHint: what happens when you send a link

read.title: You drop in a document
read.body: Clozer reads it once and for all. It recognizes its type (quote, proposal, deck, résumé…), summarizes each page and spots where the price, timeline, scope or your references are. It also notes the exact facts: “$12,000 excl. tax”, “8 weeks”, “paid in 3 installments”.

open.title: Your prospect opens their link
open.body: They see your document as usual. Clozer notes, page by page, how long they spend, when, on which device, and whether other people open it. A read only counts from their first gesture (scrolling, moving the mouse, touching the screen): mail security bots, automatic previews (Slack, LinkedIn) and your own reads don't count. If you're on Clozer at that moment, you watch them read live.

analyze.title: They close it: Clozer takes stock
analyze.body: A few minutes after they read, Clozer rebuilds the prospect's story as dated facts (“Sunday 9 pm, on mobile, 3 min on pricing, stops at page 9”) and an AI reads it the way a seasoned salesperson would: where the sale stands, what's blocking (price, decision-maker, timing…), what to do next. Every conclusion cites the facts behind it; anything unproven is dropped.

write.title: If a follow-up is needed, Clozer writes it
write.body: In your name, with your offer and the real numbers from the document, on the angle that matters to this prospect. For example: “If budget is the snag, we can spread the payments. Got 15 minutes to talk?” Never “I saw you looked at the pricing”: the prospect must never feel watched.

timing.title: It picks the right time
timing.body: Never right after a read (that would feel like surveillance), always during the prospect's business hours, 3 follow-ups a month at most, and nothing right after a conversation you logged.

approve.title: You approve, or it sends on its own
approve.body: By default, the follow-up waits for you: an email lets you know, and you'll find it in “Follow-ups to approve” on the dashboard and on the prospect's page. You reread it, tweak it or have it rewritten, then approve. On Autopilot, only safe follow-ups go out on their own. The prospect's replies land in your inbox. For a link, the follow-up goes out from Clozer's address in your name, with your email as reply-to; for a campaign, from your mailbox, in the thread.

watch.title: And it keeps watching
watch.body: Silence after a reading: it takes stock again and adjusts what's next. Link never opened: a reminder 3, 7 then 14 days after sending. The prospect replies by email, clicks “Approve” or “Ask for a change”: everything stops and you're notified. You got them on the phone: log the call in one click, Clozer takes it into account.

howItWorks.temperatureBody: How much they read. Computed without AI: recent reading, time spent, repeat visits, several readers, pricing read, read to the end. Every point has its reason, shown on the prospect's page. A reader nobody named never turns “Hot”: there is no one to call yet.
howItWorks.aiReadBody: What it means. The AI interprets: a prospect can be “hot” (lots of reads) with a cautious AI read (short reads, too early to tell). Confidence says how sure the AI is: low when there are few signals.

rules.noHint: Never a hint that you see what they read: a check blocks any sentence that would give it away.
rules.noInvented: Never a number or date that isn't in your document: a check verifies every amount.
rules.cap: 3 follow-ups a month per contact at most, a few days apart.
rules.timing: Never in the hours after a read, always during the prospect's business hours.
rules.single: Only one follow-up in the works per prospect: a newer analysis replaces the old one.
rules.privateNotes: Your private notes on a prospect feed the analysis, never the writing of a message.

howItWorks.you1: Describe your offer once, in <link>Settings</link> (optional: Clozer works it out from your first document).
howItWorks.you2: Drop in a document and create one link per prospect.
howItWorks.you3: Approve the suggested follow-ups, and call when Clozer tells you to.
howItWorks.you4: Log your calls and replies in one click on the prospect's page.
howItWorks.underTheHood1: Two AI models from Anthropic. Claude Haiku, the fast one, reads documents and runs a second check before any automatic send. Claude Sonnet, the more thoughtful one, analyzes each prospect and writes the follow-ups.
howItWorks.underTheHood2: No email address or IP address is sent to the AI: readers go by a letter (reader A, reader B…). An analysis only reruns when something new has happened.
howItWorks.notYet2: Replies to your own email (not a Clozer follow-up) are only seen with the extension in Gmail, or when your cold email tool reports them: otherwise, log them on the prospect's page.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything people ask us about Clozer: documents, links, follow-ups, team, data. Question missing? The assistant answers you.
faq.noMatchHint: The help assistant answers you right away.
faq.notFoundBody: Ask the assistant, or send an idea or a bug to the team.
